version.changelog: Compatibility verified on OpenClaw 2026.9.3 (controlled details picker). Docs: the GitHub package now ships a Windows auto-repair watchdog that re-injects the enhancement after an upgrade wipes dist/control-ui; it is not part of this artifact. No functional change to the portable core.

llm.summary: This skill is a local OpenClaw UI patch that is broadly coherent and reversible, with one disclosure issue around same-origin update polling.

dimensions.detail: Writing into the OpenClaw package directory is expected for this UI patch, and cleanup is pattern-limited to pcl-model-picker.v*.js files; users should still expect local package-file modification.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The PowerShell installer auto-detects or accepts an explicit Control UI dist path, backs up index.html, injects or replaces a marked script tag, copies a versioned asset, and supports -Remove.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly describes the UI changes, install, verify, and uninstall steps, but its 'no network access' claims conflict with the injected script's same-origin update check.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The enhancement persists as an injected browser script until removed or overwritten by an OpenClaw upgrade; the ClawHub artifact does not include the separate scheduled watchdog mentioned in the docs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to improve the OpenClaw Control UI model picker, and the artifacts implement a browser-side DOM/CSS enhancement plus an installer that injects one script tag and copies one JS asset.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this modifies your local OpenClaw Control UI files and adds a browser script that periodically makes a same-origin request to the Control UI root for update checking. Use -Remove to uninstall if you do not want the injected picker or background same-origin polling.
llm.findings: [other] expected: Verified: scripts/pcl-model-picker.v6.js performs fetch('./', {cache:'no-store', credentials:'same-origin'}) after 30 seconds and every five minutes to compare build metadata and reload if newer. This is purpose-aligned with the self-update feature and no external exfiltration or code execution was found, but the documentation should not claim 'no network access'.
